body.name: \mathfrak C_K
body.def: The certified hierarchical noncompact routine on a declared candidate face A: it uses an independent Gaussian screen–decision split, applies certified compact quotient selectors to every retained nonempty subset, and certifies the outer design over the Bernoulli hit polytope or exact-count simplex by rational branch-and-bound. Global candidate adaptation takes the full face with positive information for every candidate; an action-relevant zero rate has extended value +infinity.
